newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland Bank says key rate can go below repo-paper.
newsitem.headline: Finland Bank says key rate can go below repo-paper.

text.p: The Bank of Finland does not rule out that its tender rate could fall below the German repo rate, Bank of Finland governor Sirkka Hamalainen was quoted as saying on Wednesday.
"It is not excluded in principle but we do not predict our own actions," Hamalainen was quoted as saying in Helsingin Sanomat newspaper.
She said that if the markka remains stable and inflation is the same as in other European countries, Finnish rates should be about the same as elsewhere.
Hamalainen said that linking the markka to the ERM did not change monetary policy but added that this now had two targets -- low inflation and a sufficiently stable currency.
She also said stable fiscal policy and labour market commitment to the new currency regime would prevent pressures on interest rates in ERM.
